review.title: Events to arm/disarm

triggers.title: Choose events
triggers.description:
Tick the events whose Hik-Connect push this switch should turn on and off. Each entry is an event type and a camera.

**What the types mean**
- **Intrusion**: a person or vehicle enters a zone (AcuSense, the usual choice)
- **Motion**: general motion detection
- **Line crossing / Region entrance / Region exiting**: other smart events, only if you use them
- **Tamper**: camera covered or moved
- **Video loss**: camera offline
- **Scene change**: view of the camera changed

**Tips**
- Preselected are the events that notify Hik-Connect on the NVR right now. If nothing is preselected, the NVR is currently disarmed: arm it first, or tick what you use.
- Ticking an event that was not armed before will start sending push for it when you arm.
- An event whose detection is turned off on the camera never fires, so ticking it has no effect.
- Cameras that are offline do not appear in the list.
